name: Selank
description: Synthetic 7-amino-acid peptide: tuftsin (Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg) with Pro-Gly-Pro added to slow breakdown

note.text: A handful of small Russian studies, published in Russian, mostly without placebo. No trial is registered on ClinicalTrials.gov.

bullets: **In rat brain membranes,** changed GABA binding, likened to benzodiazepines
**In rats,** nasal doses changed GABA-linked gene activity in hours
**In lab tests,** slowed enzymes that break down enkephalins
**In people,** the mechanism is not established

practical.routes: Not established in people (nasal in rats)
practical.soldAs: No approved product; not on FDA compounding lists

regulatory.text: Not in the Oct 2026 peptide policy
Not named; S0 status not stated

references: FDA, bulk drug substances that may present significant safety risks (Category 2), Apr 2026
Front Pharmacol, Selank and GABA-linked genes in rats, Feb 2016
J Clin Pharmacol, review of phenibut and Selank, Aug 2021
